page.overview:
What is Through the Never?

Through the Never is the seventh track of Metallica's fifth self titled studio album, better known as The Black Album. The song itself was composed by James Hetfield, Lars Ulrich, and Kirk Hammett.

The song explores themes of existentialism, the vastness of the universe, the relentless quest for knowledge, truth, and survival, and human curiosity. The lyrics describing the unknown "through the never" shows the incomprehension of human understanding and the drive to explore space and existence.

All that is, was and will be Universe much too big to see

Time and space never ending Disturbing thoughts, questions pending Limitations of human understanding
